title: Survival Of The Fittest
paragraphs: “Alright then! We need to hold a welcome party for Wyndia-chan. I’ll go all out, so look forward to it!”
Since Assistant has only known the wild, she doesn’t yet understand the taste of Father’s homemade cooking. For reference, the previous Assistant was completely obsessed with his food.
“More importantly…”
Assistant handed the egg to Father.
“You’re going to make an egg dish with this egg, aren’t you!?”
“No!”
Assistant glared at me intensely.
“Motoyasu-kun, you’re joking on purpose, right?”
“I’m not joking.”
“A serious face… That makes it even worse!”
After scolding me, Father looked at Assistant. It seems like he was serious—he really wasn’t planning to cook the egg.
“Oh, you mean the registration. As the egg’s guardians, you and I need to register.”
“Yeah, I want to do it quickly.”

Assistant, as if she already knew what to do, bit her finger and smeared her blood on the egg. Father also pricked his finger lightly with a knife, letting his blood fall onto the egg to complete the registration.
“Alright, it’s done.”
“I wonder how soon it’ll hatch… Will it be a little brother? Or a little sister?”
“Who knows?”

Father and Assistant chatted as they waited. Before I knew it, they had already grown closer. As expected of Father. With that, he started preparing breakfast. When breakfast was ready, Ren, Itsuki, and Éclair woke up, introduced themselves to Assistant, and finished their meal. At first, Assistant was cautious about the food Father had made, but soon enough, she started devouring it hungrily. That was quite an impression.
“Well, it’s fine if she eats with her hands at first.”
“She’ll gradually learn table manners.”

Ren seemed to be struggling with how to interact with Assistant, probably still somewhat influenced by the previous loop. Itsuki, on the other hand, appeared to be engaging in conversation normally. Éclair seemed like she would be strict about manners.
“So, we’ve accomplished our goal. Now, there’s the matter of Éclair?”
“Yeah. But before that, we should probably do some leveling for Wyndia-chan and the newly hatched one.”

Since Assistant was present, we couldn’t speak openly about our situation, which was quite frustrating. By the way, Father had thoroughly warned me in advance, so I kept quiet. Either way, if we didn’t strengthen Rival to some extent, it would be difficult to extract information from the Dragon Emperor of Faubrey.
“Sakura-chan is…”
“That kid is fine, but dragons are a no-go!”
“I don’t like them.”
“No way.”
“Sigh… Filolials really have troublesome tendencies.”
“The best approach would be power leveling to forcibly raise their strength…”
“With our current strength, we should be fine. While heroes can’t boost each other, our companions aren’t bound by that limitation.”
That’s true. However, let me just say this.
“I refuse. I won’t help raise Rival’s level.”
“Yeah, I figured you’d say that, so I wasn’t planning to ask you, Motoyasu-kun. No worries.”

Oh? I feel like I’ve been completely sidelined. I can’t let this be misunderstood. It’s not that I don’t want to help Rival—I simply have no interest in that. Helping Father, on the other hand, is an honor.
“Naofumi-san, I want to be of service to you! Being left out is unbearable!”
“I’m not really leaving you out, but…”
Father answered me with a slightly troubled expression.
“For now, we’ll help Wyndia-san level up, and Motoyasu-san’s group will have to figure something out on their own.”
“Hmm… I see. If there’s something Motoyasu-kun’s group could do…”
Suddenly, Father seemed to have an idea and motioned me over. I immediately ran up to him.
“What is it?”
“Could I ask you to collect fragments of the Dragon Emperor?”

Oh! What a brilliant idea! Those dragons are the natural enemies of the great Filolials. As their nemesis, dragons’ power cannot be underestimated. More importantly, the knowledge contained within the Dragon Emperor’s fragments would be invaluable.
“It’s a good idea, but are you sure Motoyasu will be okay with indirectly aiding in the strengthening of dragons?”
“I’ll do it! It’s dragon hunting time!”
Assistant glared at me. Heh… Dragon hunting is my duty alongside the Filolials. I’ll gather countless Dragon Emperor fragments!
“Ah, don’t misunderstand, Wyndia-chan. We’re not going after your father… uh, it’s just that these fragments are necessary to enhance that little one’s basic abilities.”
“From her perspective, it’s still killing her own kind. It’s only natural she’d feel uneasy.”
“Survival of the fittest. The Shield Hero is right about that.”
Assistant firmly rejected Ren’s sympathy. Ren’s face twitched slightly. He had just learned another harsh lesson about reality.
“I will raise someone who won’t lose to Father. That way, he will surely acknowledge me!”
“That’s right. Let’s do our best.”
Assistant clenched her fists, showing her determination. It seems she had been taught by her parent that the fragments were important.
“So, for the time being, I should focus on searching for the Dragon Emperor and collecting fragments, correct?”
“Basically, yes. But don’t forget about going to Faubrey. This is only until we confirm Éclair’s situation.”
“That means we have a few days at most?”
“Hmm… It’s a bit vague, but maybe it would be best to quickly suppress the Wave in Melromarc and then escape to Faubrey using the portal.”
“We should just ignore the Wave in a country that pulls this kind of stunt.”
“But we already heard about it from Motoyasu-kun regarding the previous cycle.”

In the previous cycle’s Wave, only Ren and Itsuki participated, which resulted in significant damage. If we were there, it would have been over in an instant. But Father is kindhearted. He said something like, “Now that I’ve heard about it, I can’t just ignore it.” The Father from the first world would have ignored it without hesitation.

“Besides, it’s not just out of goodwill. If we quickly suppress the Wave and show that we are fighting for the world, we’ll gain allies more easily. It makes us appear as heroes who refuse to yield to conspiracies and only focus on the crisis at hand.”
“I see…”
“Even if they’re our enemies, if we come to save them, it creates a favorable image, regardless of our true intentions. In a way, it would embody the very concept of a hero.”
“Maybe we should have tackled the Waves in Siltvelt too. We need to get used to dealing with them to some extent, so I’m thinking we shouldn’t set a strict deadline. What do you think?”
Father had put a lot of thought into this. Naturally, no one objected, and the discussion was mostly settled.

Just as we were talking, we heard a cracking sound coming from the egg Assistant was holding. As we turned our eyes to it, a form gradually emerged from the shell. The color and shape… Could it be the young form of the previous Rival? Then again, it had grown a bit since last time. I wasn’t entirely sure.
“Gau…!”
With a lively cry, a baby dragon peeked out of the egg, a piece of shell still resting on its head.
“This is a dragon?”
“Yeah, a child of the monster that took care of Father and me… When it laid an egg, it said it wanted the baby to be my little brother or sister.”
“Huh… So it really is like a sibling to you, Wyndia-chan.”
“Gau!”
Rival let out a cry toward Father and Assistant. Assistant pulled Rival out of its shell and started licking off the mucus. Itsuki seemed slightly disturbed. Ren averted his gaze.
“Umm, is it a boy or a girl?”
“Seems like a girl.”
“Huh… What should we name her?”
“Ga—Gyau!”
For a moment, her eyes changed. Even her cry sounded different. Assistant tilted her head.
“What’s wrong?”
“She… already has a name. Even though she’s just a baby.”
“Really?”
“Yeah, she said she heard it while still in the egg. Or maybe Father ordered her to remember it.”
“What’s the name?”
“Gaelion. She said Father allowed her to use his name while she was still in the egg.”
“I see. That’s a cool name. Are you okay with that, even though you’re a girl?”
“Gau!”
Rival let out a cry as if nodding at Father’s words.
“Seems like she’s fine with it. Welcome, Gaelion. Let’s grow strong like Father.”
“Gau!”
And so, even Rival officially joined our group.
